description: The plot titled “output_gate” illustrates how the maximum activation value varies across model layers for four signals: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 23 with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 400 with labeled ticks every 50 units. The attn_output series is drawn as a blue dashed line with no markers; it starts near 0 at layer 0, stays in the low single digits through roughly the first half of layers, rises into the teens around the mid-to-late layers, and ends near about 110 at layer 23. The attn_residual series is an orange dotted line with no markers; it begins near 0 at layer 0, increases gradually through early layers (around the teens by roughly layer 4–5), continues rising through mid layers, then accelerates in the final layers, ending near about 260 at layer 23. The ffn_output series is a green dash-dot line with no markers; it starts near 0 at layer 0, remains close to 0–5 through much of the early and mid layers, increases into the teens in later layers, and finishes near about 160 at layer 23. The ffn_residual series is a red solid line with no markers; it begins near 0 at layer 0, rises to around the mid-teens by about layer 4–5, continues increasing steadily through mid layers, then climbs sharply in the last few layers, reaching roughly 180 around layer 22 and ending near about 390 at layer 23.
